const.attempt_boundary: no attempt is created beyond max_attempts
const.pre_disposition: persist outbox status reconcile and route retry_exhausted, then query destination evidence
const.confirmed_success: persist an exact M0 ActionReceipt with outcome confirmed_success
const.confirmed_not_applied: persist attempt status reconciled_not_applied and outbox route retry_exhausted_not_applied before constructing an exact confirmed_failure receipt; then retain done outbox route retry_exhausted
const.unproven: persist attempt status unknown and outbox route human_reconciliation; stop automatic query and dispatch
const.outer_boundary: leave the M4B run active; the outer run FSM owns RETRIES_EXHAUSTED and any terminal transition
